biotools.summary: ISN-tractor is a Python library designed for the fast and scalable computation of individual-specific networks (ISNs) from omics data. It enables the analysis of individual-specific relationships between biological entities and supports various data types, including transcriptomics, proteomics, and genotype arrays.
